standard_prerequisites.name: Tensor products of constant sheaves with finitely presented modules
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stacks Project, Modules on Sites, Lemma lemma-tensor-with-finitely-presented (tag 09BK)
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the sheaf-level tensor product with the constant sheaf of the module tensor product.

core_obligations: Reduce by the flatness criterion to showing injectivity of the map on tensor products with a finitely generated ideal I of the coherent ring (proof lines 8467-8469).
Use coherence to see that I is finitely presented, hence that the tensor product of the constant sheaf of M with the constant sheaf of I is the constant sheaf of M tensor I (proof lines 8470-8472).
Use flatness of M to make M tensor I -> M injective, hence the induced map of constant sheaves injective, and conclude flatness of the sections over U (proof lines 8473-8475).
proof_roadmap: Reduce flatness to the finitely generated ideal criterion.
Move between module and sheaf tensor products using finite presentation.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a coherent ring and a flat module M, the sections of the constant sheaf attached to M over any object of the site form a flat module. The proof uses the criterion that flatness may be checked on finitely generated ideals: for such an ideal I the map M tensor I -> M is injective by flatness of M, and since coherence makes I finitely presented, the tensor product of the constant sheaves computes the constant sheaf of the tensor product, so the induced map of constant sheaves is injective, which gives the required injectivity after taking sections (proof lines 8466-8475). H2: the transfer between the module-level and sheaf-level tensor products using finite presentation is the substance.
